name: On a échangé nos Chefs
source:
Donald has recently been at the helm of a wealthy American company. Since his appointment, he keeps repeating that he will restore the coat of arms of society.

Employees, admiring their former boss, have trouble adapting to the spirit of start-up and the philosophy of "coolness" that Donald wants to put in place: they are exhausted.

Fortunately for them, the latest trend in fashion may seduce them.

Donald decided to spend a week with another leader. But what he does not know is that his replacement will be ... A ficus!

[From [url=https://ladropzone.itch.io/on-a-echange-nos-chefs] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
唐纳德最近掌管了一家富裕的美国公司。上任后，他不断重复自己要恢复社会的荣光。

员工们崇拜前任老板，却难以适应唐纳德想要建立的创业精神与“酷”哲学：他们已经筋疲力尽。

幸运的是，最新的时尚潮流或许能吸引他们。

唐纳德决定与另一名领导者互换一周。但他不知道，自己的替代者会是……一株榕树！

（来源：[url=https://ladropzone.itch.io/on-a-echange-nos-chefs]itch.io[/url]）
